{"people":[{"name":"Sam","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Farah","role":"Solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Lucy","role":"Ecommerce director, champion","side":"customer"},{"name":"Martin","role":"CFO, final decider","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Controller, built the rate one-pager","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"IT lead","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Their bank (Fiserv processing relationship)","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Fiserv (through their bank)"],
"incumbent":"Fiserv through their bank, had been forever",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their ecommerce director, Lucy, came inbound.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Inbound lead from the ecommerce director; she was the origin of the evaluation."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"She said about one in twelve online orders was failing at the payment step, and it was worse on the big baskets.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Core pain with a number; worse on high-value orders."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Customers would call in annoyed, or just not come back.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Customer impact of failures; source unclear, not quantified."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"she couldn't get a straight answer from the processor on why.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","competitor"],"note":"Incumbent processor gave no explanation of failures; a dissatisfaction with the incumbent."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Her number. Off their own dashboard.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The one-in-twelve figure is the customer's own data, not ours."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"The CFO, Martin.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Names the CFO as final decider."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"Lucy was the champion, she wanted it, IT was fine with it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's read of stakeholders; later IT is described as nervous and conditional."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"Martin said no. Lucy told me. I never met him.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Decision known only secondhand; rep never had access to the decider."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Lucy said he doesn't take vendor meetings and she'd carry it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Champion carried the case to the decider alone."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"They were on Fiserv through their bank, had been forever.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Identifies a long-standing incumbent bundled with their bank."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"What Lucy told me is that when the bank heard, they came back and sharpened the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent responded with a price cut once it learned of the evaluation."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"No new product, nothing. Just a better rate.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's characterization of the competitor response."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"Up to then Lucy was asking about declines. Why big orders fail, what we'd do about it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Before the bank countered, the conversation centered on declines and value."},
{"id":"E14","turn":12,"excerpt":"After the bank came back, every email was the rate. Can you do better on the rate.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","decided"],"note":"Observable shift in customer questions from declines to price."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"Lucy loved the checkout. And the decline piece.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read of what resonated with the champion."},
{"id":"E16","turn":14,"excerpt":"When our solutions engineer, Farah, explained why big-ticket orders get knocked back and what we do about it, Lucy was nodding the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Observed reaction to the decline explanation."},
{"id":"E17","turn":14,"excerpt":"Silence, honestly, nothing bombed. It was a good cycle. We lost on price.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","outcome"],"note":"Rep says no gaps; later reveals no value figure reached the CFO."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"he's not going to pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy (relaying Martin)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language","outcome"],"note":"Moment of loss; CFO saw no difference from the incumbent."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"Right before that she'd been telling me it was a formality.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","decider"],"note":"The champion misjudged the decider; the loss was a surprise."},
{"id":"E20","turn":18,"excerpt":"The controller did a one-pager for Martin. Our rate, their rate, side by side.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","decider"],"note":"The decision artifact was a rate-only comparison built by the customer."},
{"id":"E21","turn":20,"excerpt":"Yeah. The per-transaction number.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"The comparison was limited to the per-transaction rate."},
{"id":"E22","turn":20,"excerpt":"they pay a gateway fee on top, and they've got a person who does nothing but chargebacks.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Unquantified hidden costs of the incumbent that never reached the page."},
{"id":"E23","turn":20,"excerpt":"But that's not on the statement line, so it wasn't on the page.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Total cost was absent from the decision document."},
{"id":"E24","turn":22,"excerpt":"Our quote.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Only our price was on the page, no value."},
{"id":"E25","turn":24,"excerpt":"I wasn't in the room. Lucy presented it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Our case was presented by the champion without us."},
{"id":"E26","turn":24,"excerpt":"Why would I pay more for the same thing.","label":"quote","speaker":"Martin (secondhand via Lucy)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","language","outcome"],"note":"Wording differs from the T16 version despite 'what I told you'."},
{"id":"E27","turn":26,"excerpt":"Which it isn't. But that's what he said.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Rep disputes 'same thing' but has no evidence that reached the CFO."},
{"id":"E28","turn":28,"excerpt":"We showed the uplift slide. The average improvement in acceptance.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Value was shown as a generic average, not specific to Fernbrook."},
{"id":"E29","turn":28,"excerpt":"Lucy got it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Value landed with the champion, not the decider."},
{"id":"E30","turn":30,"excerpt":"Not in a doc, no.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No Fernbrook-specific value figure was ever produced."},
{"id":"E31","turn":30,"excerpt":"Farah offered to run their declines. She wanted a three-month export so she could show what the failed orders were worth.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"Value analysis was offered but never done."},
{"id":"E32","turn":30,"excerpt":"it was the last two weeks of the quarter, and I didn't want to slow things down.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Quarter-end pressure drove the decision to skip the business case."},
{"id":"E33","turn":30,"excerpt":"Lucy was sold. I didn't think we needed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"Rep sold to the champion, not the decider."},
{"id":"E34","turn":32,"excerpt":"Nothing from us.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"The CFO had no cost-of-failure figure from us."},
{"id":"E35","turn":32,"excerpt":"I assume Lucy told him.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Unverified assumption about what the decider heard."},
{"id":"E36","turn":34,"excerpt":"Yes. Probably.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Hedged claim that matching price wins; rep walks it back immediately."},
{"id":"E37","turn":34,"excerpt":"their IT lead was a bit nervous about moving before spring, that's their whole year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Seasonal migration risk; contradicts 'IT was fine with it'."},
{"id":"E38","turn":34,"excerpt":"He'd said he'd do it if finance approved.","label":"fact","speaker":"IT lead (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"IT support was conditional on finance approval."},
{"id":"E39","turn":34,"excerpt":"And Martin would still have been looking at a page that said same rate, so why move. So maybe not only the rate.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","gaps"],"note":"Rep concedes price was not the only cause."},
{"id":"E40","turn":34,"excerpt":"But the rate is what killed it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep reverts to price as the cause."},
{"id":"E41","turn":36,"excerpt":"Lucy asked once if we had something she could hand Martin. Like a one-page business case.","label":"fact","speaker":"Lucy (relayed by rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"Explicit request for a CFO-ready business case."},
{"id":"E42","turn":36,"excerpt":"I sent her the deck and the pricing proposal.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Request answered with generic materials, not a business case."},
{"id":"E43","turn":38,"excerpt":"The customer stories. The average uplift.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"The deck's 'business case' was generic proof, not Fernbrook numbers."},
{"id":"E44","turn":40,"excerpt":"orders dying at the last step.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's words for declines."},
{"id":"E45","turn":40,"excerpt":"the big baskets.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's words for high-value orders."},
{"id":"E46","turn":40,"excerpt":"we do all the work to get someone to buy a four-thousand-dollar greenhouse and then the card says no.","label":"quote","speaker":"Lucy","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Vivid, concrete pain with a dollar figure."},
{"id":"E47","turn":40,"excerpt":"From Martin, secondhand, all I have is \"the same thing.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider"],"note":"Only decider language available is secondhand and commodity-framed."},
{"id":"E48","turn":42,"excerpt":"If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's final takeaway is price, despite conceding other factors."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E7","E37","E38"],"what":"Rep says IT was fine with it, then says the IT lead was nervous about moving before spring and would only do it if finance approved."},
{"evidence":["E17","E34","E39","E41"],"what":"Rep says nothing bombed and it was lost on price, then admits the CFO had nothing from us on cost of failures, a business case was requested, and 'maybe not only the rate'."},
{"evidence":["E39","E40","E48"],"what":"Rep concedes the loss was 'maybe not only the rate', then reasserts the rate killed it and more rate room would have won."},
{"evidence":["E18","E26"],"what":"Martin's line is relayed two ways: 'he's not going to pay more for the same thing' vs 'Why would I pay more for the same thing', yet the rep says it is 'what I told you'."},
{"evidence":["E19","E8"],"what":"The champion called it a formality right before the CFO said no; the champion's read of the decider was wrong."},
{"evidence":["E27","E24","E34"],"what":"Rep insists it isn't 'the same thing', but the only thing from us on the decision page was our quote."},
{"evidence":["E33","E41"],"what":"Rep says Lucy was sold and a value analysis wasn't needed, yet Lucy asked for something to hand Martin."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":14,"what":"Answered 'nothing bombed' and pivoted to price; later reveals the business case and value figure never reached the CFO."},
{"question":"Did we put a figure on the value they'd get? / A figure for Fernbrook.","turn":28,"what":"First answered with the generic uplift slide; only on follow-up admitted 'Not in a doc, no.'"},
{"question":"So what did Martin have in front of him about what one in twelve orders was costing?","turn":32,"what":"Hesitated, then said 'Nothing from us' and deflected to an assumption that Lucy told him."},
{"question":"If we had matched the price, would we have won?","turn":34,"what":"'Yes. Probably.' then hedged with IT timing and the same-rate page, then reverted to price."},
{"question":"Was there a business case in the deck?","turn":38,"what":"Did not say yes or no; listed customer stories and average uplift."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"orders dying at the last step","ours":"declines / improvement in acceptance","evidence":["E44","E13","E28"]},
{"theirs":"the big baskets","ours":"big-ticket orders","evidence":["E45","E16"]},
{"theirs":"the card says no","ours":"knocked back / declines","evidence":["E46","E16","E13"]},
{"theirs":"the same thing","ours":"uplift slide / average improvement in acceptance (rep: 'Which it isn't')","evidence":["E18","E26","E27","E28"]},
{"theirs":"something she could hand Martin ... a one-page business case","ours":"the deck and the pricing proposal / customer stories / average uplift","evidence":["E41","E42","E43"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E8","E18","E26"],"what":"Lost: CFO Martin said no, framing us as paying more for the same thing."},
{"evidence":["E10","E11","E14"],"what":"Incumbent Fiserv, through their bank, retained the business after sharpening the rate."},
{"evidence":["E20","E23","E24","E34"],"what":"The decision was made on a rate-only one-pager with no value or total-cost figure from us."},
{"evidence":["E37","E38"],"what":"Secondary risk: IT was nervous about moving before spring and conditional on finance approval."},
{"evidence":["E8"],"what":"Whole deal lost; nothing in the transcript indicates any part of the business moved."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says IT was fine with it, then says the IT lead was nervous about moving before spring and would only do it if finance approved.
Rep says nothing bombed and it was lost on price, then admits the CFO had nothing from us on cost of failures, a business case was requested, and 'maybe not only the rate'.
Rep concedes the loss was 'maybe not only the rate', then reasserts the rate killed it and more rate room would have won.
Martin's line is relayed two ways: 'he's not going to pay more for the same thing' vs 'Why would I pay more for the same thing', yet the rep says it is 'what I told you'.
The champion called it a formality right before the CFO said no; the champion's read of the decider was wrong.
Rep insists it isn't 'the same thing', but the only thing from us on the decision page was our quote.
Rep says Lucy was sold and a value analysis wasn't needed, yet Lucy asked for something to hand Martin.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Answered 'nothing bombed' and pivoted to price; later reveals the business case and value figure never reached the CFO.

dodges.question: Did we put a figure on the value they'd get? / A figure for Fernbrook.
dodges.what: First answered with the generic uplift slide; only on follow-up admitted 'Not in a doc, no.'

dodges.question: So what did Martin have in front of him about what one in twelve orders was costing?
dodges.what: Hesitated, then said 'Nothing from us' and deflected to an assumption that Lucy told him.

dodges.question: If we had matched the price, would we have won?
dodges.what: 'Yes. Probably.' then hedged with IT timing and the same-rate page, then reverted to price.

dodges.question: Was there a business case in the deck?
dodges.what: Did not say yes or no; listed customer stories and average uplift.

outcome_signals.what: Lost: CFO Martin said no, framing us as paying more for the same thing.
Incumbent Fiserv, through their bank, retained the business after sharpening the rate.
The decision was made on a rate-only one-pager with no value or total-cost figure from us.
